objective: Long-term growth of principal and income; reasonable current income is secondary.

mandatory_constraints.text: Normal circumstances require equity exposure of at least 80% of NAV; qualifying preferred/convertible securities, rights, warrants and equity derivatives may count.
Non-US issuers outside the S&P 500 are limited to 20% of total assets.
Securities denominated in non-USD currencies are limited to 5% of total assets.

Issuer securities in a single source-defined industry cannot exceed 25% of total assets; government/GSE exceptions apply. Source uses third-party industry classifications and manager discretion, so this is not an FF12 25% cap.
For 75% of total assets, issuer exposure is limited to 5% of fund total assets and 10% of issuer voting securities, subject to stated exceptions.
mandatory_constraints.denominator: total assets and issuer voting securities

mandatory_constraints.text: Illiquid securities purchases must not result in more than 15% of NAV in illiquid securities.
Percentage restrictions apply when purchasing; later market changes do not automatically require a sale.
Underwriting, physical real estate, physical commodities, borrowing/senior securities and lending restrictions retain the statutory and instrument exceptions listed in the SAI.
Temporary defensive allocations may consist entirely of cash and cash equivalents.

capture_method: official SEC text via normal web retrieval; original HTML bytes not captured
numerical_scope_note: FF12 cannot certify security-level, country, currency, purchase-time or source-industry compliance. The common-equity sleeve mass and outside assets are held fixed, so the 80% rule is constant across feasible reallocations. No invented per-FF12 cap was imposed.
